questions.question: What should AI improve in backlog prioritization?
options: Evidence, scoring, dependency visibility, and decision logging
questions.explanation: AI can help structure input, but the prioritization rubric must stay visible.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Customer value is a core prioritization signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked backlog prioritization plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact ranks backlog scenarios and recommends controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: The scoring rubric makes prioritization transparent.

questions.question: When should a backlog item receive deeper refinement?
options: When value, effort, risk reduction, or dependency pressure needs evidence
Only when no customer is involved
Only when effort is unknown and ignored
questions.explanation: These signals require structured refinement before planning.

questions.question: Why should a decision log be kept?
options: So later teams can see why an item was prioritized or deferred
questions.explanation: Decision logs preserve context and support learning.
